name: Station 3, the head: the stair's hearth (PLAN.md section 7.3; biomes/hearths/PLAN.md section 11.5): vent 77's pit crater at the valley's head, its floor at ~2,700 m under a wall of stacked flows and red scoria, the warm spring and its moss lawn (the nemetos), one disc of broad-fanned hearth trees round it, the two tube mouths (tube_god_07 ENE, the cross-conduit SW), the older crater with its lake and the Talovolci's walled fields, the procession's way down; a winter night
